description: Header file defining the TrafficSeparationManager class for managing per-port traffic separation policies, including configuration, port management, and state tracking.

classes.name: TrafficSeparationManager
classes.description: Manages traffic separation policies for trunk and access ports, including configuration, port addition/removal, and policy application.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the traffic separation manager with a new traffic separation configuration.

methods.name: add_trunk_port
methods.description: Adds a new trunk port to be managed.

methods.name: remove_trunk_port
methods.description: Removes an existing trunk port from management.

methods.name: add_access_port
methods.description: Adds an access port (fronthaul BSS) to be managed.

methods.name: remove_access_port
methods.description: Removes an access port from management.

methods.name: apply_policies
methods.description: Applies current configuration to all managed ports.

methods.name: clear_policies
methods.description: Rolls back current policies on all managed ports.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the manager to its initial unconfigured state.

methods.name: has_config
methods.description: Checks if a traffic separation configuration is loaded.

methods.name: is_applied
methods.description: Checks if policies are currently applied.
